Commentary.Commentary: 181 needed to win. Any given side can chase or defend. However, given Sri Lanka's lackluster performance with the bat, the chances of 180 being defended appear higher. Stay tuned...

Jeffrey Vandersay is on the sidelines for an interview with Mike Haysman. He says that his team is confident of chasing this total down. Reckons they did not execute their plans with the ball but still believe that they can win. Mentions it is tough to be a bowler in these conditions. Informs us it was fun watching the previous game from the dug out. Hopes that his team's openers can provide a good start and signs off by saying that Sri Lanka are quite upbeat about chasing down the target since the ball is coming on to the bat well.

South Africa will be happy with the total but they will believe they could have got 20 more. Some tactical decisions - like sending Duminy ahead of the in-form Miller could backfire. Duminy did end up scoring 33 from 17 balls but the first few deliveries he took to get adjusted, could prove the decisive factor. Hendricks did good justice to his World Cup chances with a fluent half century while Rassie van der Dussen continues to knock on the doors for a visa to travel in the month of May.

There is nothing in the pitch but Lasith Malinga was once again at his best. 4-0-26-1 on a day with nothing happening from the heavens or from the surface beneath. But he did not get much support from the rest. Akila Dananjaya and Jeffrey Vandersay tried exerting some control in the middle overs but could not quite take wickets. Eventually, the Hendricks-van der Dussen stand started to pick out the bones and the run rate started to rise. At one stage, even 200 was looking likely but the Lankans managed to dish in some quiet overs after Hendricks was dismissed.

That is a more than competitive total posted by the Proteas. 180 is a good score on any track and the home side will back itself to defend this one. Having said that, the Proteas will know that this is a good pitch and if they scored 180, Sri Lanka too, can get 181.

FOUR! How did David Miller pick that? Outstanding shot from him. Full again on leg, Miller looks to flick but loses balance. His right leg is in the air but somehow, he connects his flick shot well and sends the ball whistling through square leg for a boundary! 15 runs from the final over and SOUTH AFRICA FINISH ON 180/3!
Full on middle, Duminy flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.

NOT OUT! Wow. An inside edge has been detected. Sri Lanka lose their review. Full on leg, Miller looked to flick but got hit on the pads. Thisara Perera appealed but the umpire shook his head. Thisara was convinced that he wanted the review and Malinga agreed. However, Ultra Edge showed a spike when the ball went past the bat.

A review. In the final over of the innings. Thisara has convinced Malinga that Miller is plumb LBW. The southpaw has been caught on the pads while attempting a flick. Where did the ball pitch? Where did it hit?
Full on middle, Duminy flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Full on middle, Duminy drives it straight past the bowler through mid on. The long on fielder cuts it off. The batsmen get two runs.
Oops... some communication or miscommunication. Malinga wants mid off up. Thisara wants mid off back. There is a lot of time-wasting done and eventually, the mid off fielder drops back.
SIX! Nice start to the last over for South Africa. THAT IS WHACKED AWAY! Full on leg, Duminy flicks it over square leg for a biggie.
Thisara Perera comes on to bowl the final over as the song, 'We will, we will, rock you!' is being played loudly in the stands. Can South Africa cross 180?
Length delivery on middle, Duminy flicks it towards mid-wicket for a run. 8 runs off the Malinga over.

BEATEN! On a good length and outside off, Miller looks to swing at this one but gets beaten on this one. It goes towards Dickwella who fumbles and gives the batsmen an easy run. The umpire gives it as a bye.
On a good length on middle, Miller looks to slog but misses the line completely.
Short delivery again, Duminy pulls it towards mid-wicket. The batsmen cross ends.
FOUR! Wonderful shot. Short of a length delivery, Duminy pulls it over square leg for a boundary.
Length delivery on leg, Miller looks to flick but gets hit low on the pads. It goes towards the leg side. The batsmen take a single. The umpire gives it as a leg bye.

SIX! Superb shot! This is JP Duminy at his best. Full and outside off, Duminy takes the aerial route and lofts it over covers for a maximum. Again, the bottom hand comes into play. 15 runs have come from the over. This is terrific batting from South Africa.
Length delivery on off, David plays it towards point for a single.
Short delivery, Duminy pulls it towards mid-wicket for a single.

WIDE! Harsh call from the umpire. This was bowled wide outside off, Duminy moves well across the stumps and lets it go. Dickwella and Udana argue with the umpire that Duminy was well across the sticks but the umpire says that the ball was further than the second wide line. Replays do not seem to show that...
FOUR! WHAT A SHOT! Great use of the bottom hand from Duminy. Full and outside off, JP Duminy hits it over extra cover for a boundary.
Short delivery, Miller pulls it over mid on for a single.
Full and outside off, almost a yorker, squeezed down to long on for a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.

A loud shout for LBW, turned down. Probably the impact was outside off. The skidder, outside off, Duminy stayed back to work it to the leg side but missed and was hit on the pads. Akila smiles after the appeal is turned down. Probably he too realizes that the impact was outside off, when Dickwella told him.
Around middle, worked through mid-wicket for a run.
Full and around off, pushed through the covers for a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Here he is. Killer Miller. At number 5.

OUT! BOWLED! The dangerous Rassie departs after a well made 64. A much needed breakthrough for Sri Lanka. It was a tossed up delivery on middle, van der Dussen came down the track to go big but ended up yorking himself. The ball sneaked through and disturbed the timber. The hosts lose their third wicket and this could be a big dent in their final score.
Full again on middle, van der Dussen drives it towards mid on for a single. 10 runs have come from the over.
WIDE! Bowls full and wide outside off, Dussen looks to go after this one but misses it.
FOUR! Poor delivery from Isru Udana. Low full toss on middle, van der Dussen flicks it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Bowls a slower ball on off, Duminy plays it towards covers for a run.
On a length outside off, Dussen looks to slog but it goes off the inner half of the bat towards mid-wicket for a run.
Full and outside off, Duminy plays it towards covers for a single.
Low full toss outside off, Rassie drives it through mid off for a single.
Isuru Udana is back on. 2-0-14-1 so far.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
JP Duminy walks in next.

OUT! Caught! The slower ball does the trick for Malinga. Rolls his fingers over the ball, lands it on a length, Hendricks looks to flick but is a touch early into the shot. The ball takes the leading edge and dies down towards mid off but Kamindu Mendis comes running in, keeps his eyes on the ball and dives forward to take a wonderful catch. The 116-run association is broken at last. Can Sri Lanka pull things back from here?
Nothing much on the Free Hit, just a pull off a short ball behind square leg. A run taken.
A NO BALL NOW. Not for overstepping. But because this is the second high bouncer of the over and accordingly signalled. Another slower ball bouncer, this time Rassie goes for the pull but misses.
FREE HIT TIME.
WIDE. A slower bouncer, around off, van der Dussen thinks about the pull but then bails out. Wide signalled for height.
FOUR! How did he play that? And what did he play? Full and wide outside off, van der Dussen reaches out and carves a square drive behind point for a boundary!
Lasith Malinga returns. 2-0-10-0 so far.

50 for Rassie van der Dussen. 2nd T20I fifty for him. It has been an outstanding innings from him. On a length on middle, Rassie flicks it towards mid-wicket. The batsmen change ends. 8 runs have come from the over. They can get to 210 from here.
Floated on middle, Reeza drives it towards mid on. The batsmen cross ends.
FOUR! Terrific shot. Full and outside off, Hendricks drives it beautifully through covers for a boundary.
Full on off, Hendricks drives it to mid off.
Short delivery on off, van der Dussen pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Short and outside off, Hendricks makes room and cuts it towards point where Dhananjaya de Silva does well to stop it. The batsmen take a run. Brilliant fielding from Dhananjaya.
On middle and off, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Driven towards the mid on region. One run added to the total.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a single.

MISFIELD, FOUR! Ordinary from Udana. Full and outside off, Hendricks leans and drives it through cover-point. Isuru Udana gets to the ball from sweeper cover but in his anxiety to pick the ball up, he loses focus and the ball slips through.
FOUR! FIFTY FOR HENDRICKS! After a slow start, Reeza has slowly picked his pace. Short and outside off, Hendricks goes back and cuts it through point for a boundary!
A left-arm to start. Around off, van der Dussen comes down the track and pushes it down to long off for a single.
Kamindu Mendis into the attack now. What will he bowl first? Left-arm or right-arm?
Tossed up on middle, Hendricks plays it through mid on. The batsmen get two runs. Good bowling by Vandersay. Just 4 runs from the over.
Full on middle, Rassie drives it towards mid on for a single.
Full toss on off, van der Dussen again plays a reverse sweep to short third man.
Floated on middle, Dussen plays a reverse sweep to short third man.
Short and outside off, Rassie looks to cut but misses it.
Tossed up on middle, Hendricks tucks it towards the leg side for a single.
Jeffrey Vandersay is back into the attack.
Flicks this through mid-wicket for a couple. A dozen from this over to follow 19 from the previous one. Is 200 on?
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a run.
FOUR! Hendricks is meaning business now. Dropped short, Reeza goes back and pulls it through mid-wicket for another boundary!
FOUR! Lovely shot. Full and outside off, Hendricks comes down the track and lofts it over cover for a boundary.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Comes down the track and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Cracking shot. Short delivery, Hendricks pulls it through square leg for a boundary. A massive over for the Proteas. 19 from it.
On the shorter side, van der Dussen plays it towards square leg for a run.
SIX! Second six in the over. This is even better from Rassie. Full on off, van der Dussen moves across and plays a slog over mid-wicket again for a maximum. This is just demolishing the bowlers.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Dropped short, pulled away for a single.
SIX! Out of the park! What about that for a strike. Rassie is turning it on here. Length delivery on middle, van der Dussen plays a slog over mid-wicket for a biggie.
The batsman failed to make contact and was hit low on the pads. The fielding side is asking the question. The umpire decides the batsman is not out.
Dropped short, Hendricks goes back and drags it via a pull wide of long on. Two runs taken.
Full again, driven through the covers for a couple more.
Very full outside off, punched through the covers for one.
A full toss now, outside off, driven down to long off for a run.
Full and outside off, eased through mid off for a single.
On a length on middle, Rassie nudges it towards square leg for a run. 11 runs have come from this over. Big over for the hosts.
SIX! First six of the innings. WHAT A SHOT! Outstanding batting from Rassie. Low full toss on off, van der Dussen gets on one knee and slogs it over mid-wicket for a maximum.
Length delivery on middle, Hendricks flicks it towards mid-wicket for a run.
On a length and outside off, Dussen covers the line of the stumps and plays it towards covers for a single.
Length delivery on middle, Hendricks flicks it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Full on middle, Dussen flicks it wide of mid on for a single.
Thisara Perera is now onto bowl.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Another wrong 'un, outside off, Reeza looks to push it through the off side but is beaten by the ball spinning in. Goes right through his legs and the keeper fumbles but manages to cling on and save byes.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Outside off, steered through third man for three.
Full and down the leg side, a googly, Hendricks misses his flick and is hit on the pads.
Floated on middle, Reeza drives it through mid on for a run. Expensive over from Akila. 11 runs have come from the over. At the end of Powerplay, South Africa are 39/1.
The keeper has spotted something and asked the bowler to stop right away. Maybe a fielder in the wrong place...
Full on middle, Dussen drives it towards mid on for a run.
Tossed up on middle, Reeza flicks it towards mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries from Reeza Hendricks. Terrific shot. Floated outside off, Hendricks plays it over wide mid off for a boundary.
FOUR! This is good batting for South Africa. Tossed up on middle, Hendricks comes down the track and hits it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Tossed up on off, Hendricks plays it to point.
On a good length on middle, Hendricks cuts it towards point for a run. 8 runs have come from the over.
On a length on middle, Dussen nudges it towards square leg for a run.
Full on off, Rassie drives it straight back towards the bowler where Udana stops it with his left foot.
FOUR! Nice shot. He made good use of his feet. Length delivery on middle, Dussen comes down the  track and lofts it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full on middle, Hendricks drives it towards mid on for a run.
Full on leg, Rassie looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It goes towards the leg side. The batsmen take a run.
Full on middle, Hendricks drives it to mid on. Good start from Akila Dananjaya. Just 4 runs from the over.
Tossed up on middle, Dussen plays it towards mid on for a run.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Hendricks flicks it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Flighted delivery on leg, Markram flicks it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Floated on middle, Reeza flicks it towards square leg for a run.
Tossed up on middle, Hendricks defends it out.
Time for spin. Akila Dananjaya is into the attack.
Outside off, punched through point for a brace.
Outside off, on a good length, Rassie plays inside the line and is beaten as the ball moves away.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Outside off, pushed straight to point.
Outside off, on a length, Hendricks plays away from the body and pushes it loosely, behind point for a single.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
FOUR! Cracking shot from Rassie van der Dussen. First ball boundary for him. Full and outside off, Dussen drives it beautifully through covers for a boundary. 6 runs and a wicket from this over.
Rassie van der Dussen is the new batsman in.

OUT! Not a great debut for Markram! He looked to cut loose and the ball was available but he holes out at mid on. A fuller length ball on the pads, Aiden looked to flick it over the head of mid on for a boundary but he does not generate enough power. The ball lobs up and goes to the right of mid on where Malinga moves and takes a good catch. Maybe the batsman should have looked to go a little more squarer there, the bat turned in his hand as he played the shot. A tad early into the attempted loft as well. Anyways, Sri Lanka have struck early here, just the start they would have liked.
Full on leg, Hendricks flicks it towards square leg for a run.
On a good length on middle, Hendricks defends it from the crease.
On a length on middle, Aiden flicks it towards mid-wicket for a run.
On a good length on middle, Markram defends it off the back foot.
Isuru Udana to bowl from the other end.
Short and outside off, Aiden cuts it through point for a run. 7 runs came off the over. Good start for South Africa.
Length delivery on middle, Hendricks flicks it towards mid-wicket for a run.
BEATEN! On a good length and outside off, Hendricks looks to slash hard but misses due to the outward movement on this one.
On a good length on off, Hendricks plays it to point.
FOUR! First boundary for South Africa. Short and outside off, Hendricks smashes it through point for a boundary. That went like a tracer bullet.
Starts with a good length on middle, Markram plays it towards third man for a single. Aiden Markram is off the mark.

We are all set to begin. The players and umpires are out in the middle. Reeza Hendricks and Aiden Markram will open the batting for South Africa. Lasith Malinga will start the proceedings for Sri Lanka.
TEAM CHANGES - Plenty of changes. Amongst the ones worth noticing, Sinethemba Qeshile is making his debut for the hosts and surprisingly, Aiden Markram is also making his debut.
TOSS - Time for the toss. Sri Lanka have won the toss and have elected to field first.

Hello and a warm welcome to the second T20I between South Africa and Sri Lanka in Centurion. The hosts won a close match in the last game thanks to the Super Over. They will be missing their main players. JP Duminy will be captaining the side and he would want his team to put up a better batting performance today. David Miller may continue his keeping duties. On the other hand, Sri Lanka would be confident and would take inspiration from their last game and play better in this one. They need to bat well because that has been their weakness in the ODI series as well. The bowlers have done well and would look to emulate the same performance as in the last game.
